title: Super Tour
text: The last minute cancellation of our tour guide turned into a bonus. Jean Claude, our back-up guide turned a great tour into a fantastic tour. His expertise in explaining the Alhambra  in three languages, his extensive historical knowledge, and a delivery that seemed National Geographic episode, made the Alhambra come alive. Bravo!!
author: Frederick_V

title: Last minute tickets Alhambra
text:
We contacted Granada Te Guia to get last minute tickets to visit the Alhambra, the whole process was very simple and transparent. Granada Te Guia was immediately very responsive and the communication was very friendly. We ended up getting last minute tickets on our own and, as the company had informed us, as soon as we notified them and cancelled the process, we were immediately refunded the full amount we had paid.
Although we did not complete the process, we still cannot help but recommend them for their friendliness, speed, proactive communication and transparency of the process.
Thank you
author: Freedom716888

title: Very good tour, friendly...
text: Very good tour, friendly and well organised. Imparted a lot of knowledge. Always happy to return. No waiting times.
author: Kevin_W

title: Unforgettable experience in Granada thanks to Juan
text:
My partner and I visited Granada for the first time, and contacted Granada Te Guía at short notice, but we couldn't be more grateful. Despite the short notice, they got tickets to visit the Alhambra and the Nasrid Palaces, something we didn’t expect given how requested these visits are.

The experience was just fantastic. Our guide was punctual, professional and, above all, passionate about the history and culture of the city.
